stories.headline: Global Climate Pact Secures Landmark Emissions Reduction Commitments
stories.summary: Nations agreed to new, ambitious targets to curb greenhouse gases by 2035, marking a critical step in combating climate change and fostering international cooperation.

stories.headline: Quantum AI Chip Achieves Record Processing Speed in Asian Lab
stories.summary: Researchers unveiled a new quantum AI chip capable of processing complex data exponentially faster, promising advancements in computing and data analysis.

stories.headline: EU Parliament Approves New Digital Services Tax on Tech Giants
stories.summary: The European Union passed legislation imposing a new tax on large digital service providers, aiming to level the playing field and boost national revenues.

stories.headline: Severe Flooding Displaces Thousands Across East African Nations
stories.summary: Torrential rains caused widespread flooding, leading to significant displacement and urgent calls for international humanitarian aid in the affected regions.

stories.headline: Breakthrough Gene Therapy Shows Promise for Rare Neurological Disorder
stories.summary: Clinical trials in the US revealed a novel gene therapy significantly slowed progression of a rare neurological disease, offering hope for patients.
